extracted.intended_audience: State educational agencies (SEAs), local educational agencies (LEAs), school administrators, and potential grant applicants (IHEs, nonprofits, community-based organizations, tribal organizations) seeking ESSA funding
extracted.subtask_description: A reference guide enumerating allowable uses of ESSA funds and which entities are eligible under specific programs (e.g., Title I–IV, Title II programs), with examples and implementation guidance for LEAs, SEAs, schools, and partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-service training to form mental health partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Carrying out in-service training for school personnel in forming partnerships between school-based mental health programs and public or private mental health organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on building capacity among school personnel to partner effectively with community mental health or health-care entities; included under uses for supporting safe/healthy students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reform principal/school leader certification and preparation systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming principal, or other school leader, certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards and approval processes to ensure that principals or other school leaders have the instructional leadership skills to help teachers teach and to help students meet challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Changes to certification/preparation must center on demonstrable instructional leadership skills tied to State academic standards and improved teacher support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reform teacher certification/licensing/preparation standards for subject-matter and teaching skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming teacher certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards and approval processes to ensure that teachers have the necessary subject-matter knowledge and teaching skills, as demonstrated through measures determined by the State, which may include teacher performance assessments, in the academic subjects that the teachers teach to help students meet challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States may adopt measures (including performance assessments) to demonstrate teacher content knowledge and instructional skill; emphasis on alignment with State standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align certification/licensing requirements with State academic standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming teacher certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards and approval processes to ensure that teacher certification or licensing requirements are aligned with such challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alignment ensures certification reflects expectations embedded in State academic standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruit qualified nontraditional candidates into educator roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Recruiting qualified individuals from other fields to become teachers, principals, or other school leaders, including mid-career professionals from other occupations, former military personnel, and recent graduates of institutions of higher education with records of academic distinction who demonstrate potential to become effective teachers, principals, or other school leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recruitment can include alternative certification pathways and targeted outreach to diverse nontraditional candidate pools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training for evaluators, coaches, mentors and school leaders on performance differentiation and feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing and providing training for school leaders, coaches, mentors, and evaluators on how accurately to differentiate performance, provide useful feedback, and use evaluation results to inform decisionmaking about professional development, improvement strategies, and personnel decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training should enable accurate performance assessment and effective use of evaluation data for PD and personnel actions; appears repeatedly as a core allowable use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruitment and retention mechanisms for effective educators
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing, improving, and implementing mechanisms to assist LEAs and schools in effectively recruiting and retaining teachers, principals, or other school leaders who are effective in improving student academic achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mechanisms may include supports targeted to underrepresented minority groups and teachers with disabilities, training for teacher leaders, and supports for instructional leadership teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differential and incentive pay for high-need subjects/areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Differential and incentive pay for teachers, principals, or other school leaders in high-need academic subject areas and specialty areas, which may include performance-based pay systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial incentives can be used to attract/retain staff in shortage areas; may include performance components as determined by State/local policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advancement and professional growth pathways with pay differentiation
rubrics_metrics.description: Teacher, paraprofessional, principal, or other school leader advancement and professional growth, and an emphasis on leadership opportunities, multiple career paths, and pay differentiation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should create clear career ladders and differentiated roles/opportunities tied to professional growth and compensation structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Induction and mentoring programs for new educators and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: New teacher, principal, or other school leader induction and mentoring programs that are designed to improve classroom instruction and student learning and achievement; and increase the retention of effective teachers, principals, or other school leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentoring/induction should be structured to support instructional improvement and retention outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiatives to improve equity in teacher distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing and implementing initiatives to assist in recruiting, hiring, and retaining effective teachers, particularly in low-income schools with high percentages of ineffective teachers and high percentages of students who do not meet the challenging State academic standards, to improve within-district equity in the distribution of teachers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include expert help in screening candidates and enabling early hiring; targeted to reduce inequitable distribution of effective teachers.

rubrics_metrics.name: State-wide STEM master teacher corps
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting the development of a State-wide STEM master teacher corps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An allowable use under Grants to Local Educational Agencies/Title II to bolster STEM instruction capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial incentives for teachers in improvement schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing financial incentives and rewards to teachers who serve in schools identified for comprehensive support and improvement activities or targeted support and improvement activities for the purpose of attracting and retaining qualified and effective teachers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incentives are aimed at improving staffing in schools undergoing improvement interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve recruitment/preparation/placement/support of principals in high-need schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Improving the recruitment, preparation, placement, support, and retention of effective principals or other school leaders in high-need schools, which may include developing or implementing leadership training programs designed to prepare and support principals or other school leaders in high-need schools, including through new or alternative pathways or school leader residency programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include cohort-based activities, residency programs, continuous professional development, and dissemination of best practices and strategies for effective school leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership cohort and team development for school improvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing and implementing programs for recruiting, developing, and placing school leaders to improve schools implementing comprehensive and targeted support and improvement activities, including cohort-based activities that build effective instructional and school leadership teams and develop a school culture, design, instructional program, and professional development program focused on improving student learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes team-based capacity building aligned to school improvement goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence-based programs to integrate health and safety into school/athletic programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing LEAs with resources that are evidence-based (to the extent the State determines that such evidence is reasonably available) addressing ways to integrate health and safety practices into school or athletic programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States and LEAs should rely on evidence-based approaches where reasonably available; can apply to athletics and general school health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissemination of best practices and program evaluation for student safety and violence prevention
rubrics_metrics.description: Disseminating best practices and evaluating program outcomes relating to any LEA activities to promote student safety and violence prevention through effective communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes evaluation and sharing of effective strategies for safety and violence prevention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bullying, harassment, and child sexual abuse awareness/prevention programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Preventing bullying and harassment; child sexual abuse awareness and prevention, such as programs or activities designed to provide age-appropriate and developmentally-appropriate instruction for students in child sexual abuse awareness and prevention, including how to recognize child sexual abuse and how to safely report child sexual abuse; and information to parents and guardians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction should be age- and developmentally-appropriate; parent/guardian information and reporting procedures included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drug and violence prevention programs with PD for personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Drug and violence prevention activities and programs that are evidence-based (to the extent the State, in consultation with LEAs in the State, determines that such evidence is reasonably available) including professional development and training for school and specialized instructional support personnel and interested community members in prevention, education, early identification, intervention mentoring, recovery support services and, where appropriate, rehabilitation referral.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers education on alcohol, tobacco, marijuana, smokeless tobacco, electronic cigarettes, and links to referral/recovery services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated student & family supports to foster effective learning skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishing learning environments and enhancing students’ effective learning skills that are essential for school readiness and academic success, such as by providing integrated systems of student and family supports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports may be family- and community-linked services that improve readiness and academic outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for youth PROMISE and locally-tailored exclusionary discipline reduction plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting LEAs in providing programs and activities that implement a youth PROMISE plan to reduce exclusionary discipline; designing and implementing a locally-tailored plan to reduce exclusionary discipline practices that is consistent with best practices and aligned with the long-term goal of prison reduction through opportunities, mentoring, intervention, support, and other education services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plans should use evidence-based strategies where reasonably available and focus on alternatives to exclusionary discipline and long-term community outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for healthy, active lifestyle and nutrition education
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting a healthy, active lifestyle, including nutritional education and regular, structured physical education activities and programs, that may address chronic disease management with instruction led by school nurses, nurse practitioners, or other appropriate specialists or professionals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs may be led by qualified health professionals and target wellness and chronic disease management.

rubrics_metrics.name: School-based mental health services and partnership programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting LEAs in expanding access to or coordinating resources for school-based counseling and mental health programs, such as through school-based mental health services partnership programs that are conducted in partnership with a public or private mental health entity or health care entity and provide comprehensive school-based mental health services and supports and staff development for school and community personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services should be trauma-informed, evidence-based (to the extent State determines evidence reasonably available), coordinated with IDEA early intervening services where appropriate, and provided by qualified mental and behavioral health professionals certified or licensed by the State and practicing within their area of expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mental health awareness training for school personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting LEAs in implementing mental health awareness training programs that are evidence-based to provide education to school personnel regarding resources available in the community for students with mental illnesses and other relevant resources relating to mental health or the safe de-escalation of crisis situations involving a student with a mental illness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training should be evidence-based where reasonably available and cover community resources and crisis de-escalation strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion of parent involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Promoting the involvement of parents in the activity or program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parental involvement is an explicit allowable use across many safe/healthy student activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay-for-success initiatives aligned with safe/healthy activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Pay for success initiatives aligned with activities to support safe and healthy students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performance-based contracting approaches may be used if aligned to safe/healthy student outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schoolwide positive behavioral interventions and supports (PBIS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementation of schoolwide positive behavioral interventions and supports, including through coordination with similar activities carried out under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, in order to improve academic outcomes and school conditions for student learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordination with IDEA and evidence-based PBIS approaches recommended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentoring and school counseling for at-risk students
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing mentoring and school counseling to all students, including children who are at risk of academic failure, dropping out of school, involvement in criminal or delinquent activities, or drug use and abuse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counseling programs may be provided by LEAs directly or via partnerships with community organizations and should target at-risk populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish/improve dropout and reentry programs and site resource coordinators
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishing or improving school dropout and reentry programs; designating a site resource coordinator to provide services, such as establishing partnerships within the community to provide resources and support for schools and ensuring alignment with academic expectations of a community school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Site coordinators connect schools with community partners and align services to academic goals; programs aim to reengage dropout students and improve continuity.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-quality training for school personnel on a range of safety/health topics
rubrics_metrics.description: High-quality training for school personnel, including specialized instructional support personnel, related to suicide prevention; effective and trauma-informed practices in classroom management; crisis management and conflict resolution techniques; human trafficking; school-based violence prevention strategies; drug abuse prevention (including educating children facing substance abuse at home); and bullying and harassment prevention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training should be high-quality, targeted to the listed topics, and may be provided directly by LEAs or through external providers with expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive and targeted support & improvement activities; evaluation and technical assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing comprehensive support and improvement activities directly (with LEA approval) or arranging for their provision through other entities; evaluating and monitoring the use of funds by LEAs receiving a grant for school improvement; providing targeted support and improvement activities directly or via providers; and providing technical assistance to LEAs serving schools implementing improvement plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes reducing barriers and providing operational flexibility for schools implementing such activities; evaluation and monitoring of funds and outcomes are explicit responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for effective school library programs and digital literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting the instructional services provided by effective school library programs and assisting schools in developing effective school library programs to provide students an opportunity to develop digital literacy skills and improve academic achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library program support is an allowable use to strengthen instructional services and digital literacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities to support school readiness and transition to elementary school
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting opportunities for principals, other school leaders, teachers, paraprofessionals, early childhood education program directors, and other early childhood education program providers to participate in joint efforts to address the transition to elementary school, including issues related to school readiness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Joint efforts should focus on continuity between early childhood settings and elementary school to improve readiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible entities for various ESSA funding uses
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligible entities vary by program and include LEAs; for-profit or nonprofit entities through a grant or contract from an LEA; LEAs in partnership with institutions of higher education (IHEs), Indian tribes, or tribal organizations; SEAs; institutions of higher education; national nonprofit entities with a demonstrated record of effectiveness; Bureau of Indian Education; community-based organizations; Indian tribes or tribal organizations; consortia of entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility depends on the specific statutory program (Titles I–V, subparts); applicants must consult the program-specific eligibility rules (e.g., Grants to Local Educational Agencies, Supporting Effective Instruction State Grants, Student Support and Academic Enrichment Grants).
